description:
amterp, Chat Notes 2026-10-12: "collapse hidden tab". Clarified 2026-10-16: every hidden pane is listed in the sidebar under what is effectively a tab called Hidden, and the ask is to collapse or expand that group.

To decide while building it:

- Whether a collapsed group still says what is inside it: a count, and the most urgent state among its panes, so a hidden helper that is blocked is not lost from view.
- Where the collapsed state lives. It is presentation rather than daemon state, so per window, kept in the window's saved arrangement beside tab order and widths, is the likely answer.
title: Collapse and expand the Hidden group in the sidebar
